name: bona-renter-skills
description: Instructions for a renter's own AI assistant: find a fitting home, understand the real cost, and move toward a sound lease.

skills.name: bona
skills.description: Help a residential renter find a fitting home, compare real costs, arrange useful tours, improve lease terms, and move toward agreement. Select the next useful Bona workflow without requiring skill names.

skills.name: bona-understand-me
skills.description: Turn a residential renter's situation into a short search brief. Use for a new search, unclear priorities, competing preferences, or a change in needs; skip intake when a concrete listing task can be answered directly.

skills.name: bona-find-homes
skills.description: Find residential rentals across accessible sources and organize saved listings into a deduplicated shortlist. Use for apartment searches or messy home lists, not as a substitute for a current unit quote or booking confirmation.

skills.name: bona-work-out-costs
skills.description: Compare the real cost of rental offers, including required fees, chosen extras, concessions, deposits, and payment timing. Use when advertised rent, move-in cash, or competing lease offers could mislead a renter.

skills.name: bona-check-a-home
skills.description: Investigate a residential listing against a renter's needs using property information, reviews, and other accessible evidence. Use for a pasted listing, policy concern, suspicious offer, or unresolved question about a home.

skills.name: bona-ask-before-a-tour
skills.description: Prepare short, property-specific questions before a rental tour or application. Use when missing costs, policies, unit details, or review concerns could change whether a renter proceeds.

skills.name: bona-plan-tours
skills.description: Help a renter choose, arrange, and prepare for property tours. Use for tour requests, booking help, or a visit plan; a tour request does not authorize an application, payment, credit check, or marketing enrollment.

skills.name: bona-learn-from-tours
skills.description: Turn a renter's tour impressions, notes, or photos into better search decisions. Use after a rental visit to update the home comparison and clarify preferences without forcing a long survey.

skills.name: bona-get-a-better-deal
skills.description: Help a renter improve a lease offer through current comparisons, useful flexibility, and a concise cooperative request. Use for rent, concessions, fees, start dates, lease length, counteroffers, or an optional renewal request informed by apartment alternatives; not legal disputes or automatic acceptance.

skills.name: bona-choose-a-home
skills.description: Help a renter choose among feasible homes and finish the next step using their priorities, full costs, tour observations, and written terms. Use for competing offers, a final shortlist, or moving from a decision toward agreement.
